notes.title: v0.9.0.0 - Endgame and Improvements Update
notes.notes:
This update contains glory levels, itemization changes, revamped XP, Onslaught modifiers, Enclave, and combat improvements.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added glory levels.
[*] Revamped the XP requirements for all levels.
[*] Overhauled Onslaught modifiers.
[*] Revamped the Enclave.
[*] Added the Enchanting Station to the Enclave where you can extract and imprint artifact effects on items.
[*] Added the ability to salvage items for ore at the Forge in the Enclave.
[*] Artifact chests now have a chance to drop artifact runes.
[*] Added a level requirement for all class abilities.
[*] Added a simple tutorial for new players.
[*] Mining now requries to time a simple minigame.
[*] Increased the maximum allowed skill points in some talents.
[*] Added abilities to all enemies.
[*] Added projectiles to some ranged class abilities.
[*] Added the following enemies: Mummy and Gargoyle.
[*] Added the following campaigns: Ashington, Parthely Citadel, Crypts of Parthely Citadel, Valley of Durosbain, and Bazaar of Durosbain.
[*] Added new steam achievements.
[/list]

[h1]Itemization Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added socket bonuses to items.
[*] Added the following tier sets: Bladestorm, Sanctus's Blessing, Raging Tempest, Fractured Souls, The High Heavens, and Holy Bulwark.
[*] Items will now increase your classes's main stat by default.
[*] Artifact items will now have special modifiers that enhance player abilities.
[*] Added a new rarity: Unique.
[*] Added Unique items which are predefined and handmade (not randomly generated).
[*] Artifact items now have a 10% chance of being a Unique item.
[*] Added more rune colors.
[*] Runes now increase a specific stat according to their color.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Merging two items will now take the tier set of the first item provided.
[*] The last player you loaded into is now automatically selected on the character selection screen.
[*] Improved the dialogue system for enemies.
[*] You are now in combat for a minimum of 4 seconds (was 1).
[*] Your minions' attacks will now put you in combat.
[*] Newly created characters now have the Health Potion, Mana Potion, and Rejuvination Potion automatically assigned to the first three consumable buttons.
[*] Improved the one button targeting system.
[*] The cardinal will now be auto deselected when he is done displaying all of his dialogue.
[*] Increased the player's interaction range.
[*] The Necromancer abilities: Noslrac's Legion and Soul Explosion now glow when you have at least one soul.
[*] You now automatically target the next available enemy when your current target dies.
[*] Casting abilities while channeling another ability will cause the channeled ability to be interupted.
[*] The campaign selector now displays what ore deposits a campaign provides.
[*] Added floating text after successfully mining to show how much ore you mined.
[*] Improved and reworked Blightbone's constant movement mechanic.
[*] Updated the visuals for the Cleric ability: Exodus.
[/list]

[h1]UI Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved the game menu.
[*] Improved the GUI buttons and the background of all panels.
[*] Improved the background of the Cleric's vigor bar.
[*] Improved the cast bar visual.
[*] An item's action buttons are now collapsed and no longer have large gaps.
[*] Added a minimap to the top right corner of the screen.
[*] Added a toggable objectives section under the minimap in the top right corner.
[*] Improved the damage numbers.
[*] Mines will now disappear after being mined on the minimap.
[*] Updated the floating text when picking up gold.
[*] Improved the buff tooltips.
[*] Improved the tooltips of items on the ground.
[*] Shortened the numbers on the health and mana orbs.
[*] Changed the glow color of procced abilities to aqua.
[*] Added a health/mana bar above the player when in combat.
[*] Added power indicators that are displayed around the player when you are able to cast spenders.
[*] Added the settings page in the main menu.
[*] Added the credits page in the main menu.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Converting an item into a tier piece increases it's item level by 30%.
[*] Reduced the quality of items rewarded from Onslaughts.
[*] You can no longer unequip and equip items while inside of an Onslaught that is active.
[*] You can no longer convert items into tier pieces and socket runes while inside of an Onslaught.
[*] Increased the base amount of ore a mine drops.
[*] Mines will now drop a higher amount of ore depending on the player's highest onslaught completed.
[*] Updated how item level is calculated.
[*] Lowered the drop chance of merge and tier tokens.
[*] Base attribute points now increase your item level.
[*] The Champion's skill: Resourceful Ambush now also increases the damage of Ambush.
[*] The Champion's abilities: King's Despair and Colossal Smash no longer have their damage increased by your currently equipped weapon.
[*] Reduced the damage of the Champion's ability: Colossal Smash.
[*] The Champion's skill: Sweeping Strikes now also causes abilties to also apply their bleeds on all targets hit.
[*] Reduced the damage of the Necromancer's abilities: Marrowripper, Hemorrhaging Assault, Raise Dead, Noslrac's Legion, Army of the Dead, and Soul Explosion.
[*] The Necromancer's skill: Final Service now casts Soul Explosion at 1/2/3/4/5% (was 5/7/9/11/15%).
[*] Removed the cast time of the Necromancer's ability: Soul Explosion.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Necromancer's skill: Hemorrhaging Assault was not properly increaseing the damage of Hemorrhaging Assault.
[*] Reduced the damage of the Wizard's abilities: Fireball, Vaporize, Meteor Strike, Meteor Shower, and Incinerate.
[*] The Wizard's skill: Improved Meteor Strike now causes targets to burn for 5/10/15/20/25% of damage dealt by Meteor Strike (was 30/35/40/45/50%).
[*] The Wizard's skill: Smoldering Crater now causes targets to burn for 10/14/20% of damage dealt by Meteor Shower (was 5/7/10%).
[*] The Wizard's ability: Meteor Shower now generates a Combustion charge while Cremation is active.
[*] The Cleric's ability: Atonement now has it's damage increased by your currently equipped weapon.
[*] Reduced the damage of the Cleric's abilities: Holy Malice, Atonement, Crusade, and Redemption.
[*] Increased the duration of the Cleric's ability: Exodus by 10 seconds.
[*] Crafted items will now have their power increased if they are a Heavy or Medium equipment (without costing more Ore).
[*] Increased the cooldown of the Necromancer's ability: Army of the Dead to 6 minutes (was 4 minutes).
[*] Reduced the cooldown of the Wizard's ability: Time Anomaly to 2 minutes (was 6 minutes).
[*] Reduced the cooldown of the Wizard's ability: Freezing Typhoon to 8 seconds (was 15 seconds).
[*] Updated how some buffs stack.
[*] Your health and mana regeneration are now based on your invested dexterity points (instead of total).
[*] Onslaught Keys will now drop from 3 levels below to 1 level above your highest onslaught level completed (was percentage based).
[*] Abilities casted by items/skills will now deal 50% reduced damage.
[*] The Champion's ability: King's Despair can no longer be casted when you have less than 5 demolish charges.
[*] The Champion's ability: Final Stand now heals you for 10% of your maximum health (was 5%).
[*] The Cleric's ability: Redemption now deals damage as if the target was at 20% of their maximum health when procced (was 35%).
[*] The Necromancer's ability: Sacrifice now grants 25% of your maximum mana (was 10%).
[*] The Cleric's ability: Divine Judgement now causes the other spender to be free (was both).
[*] Enemies now grant 10 to 20 XP when killed, regardless of level (was based on the enemy level).
[*] Completing campaigns on the main campaign now grants 500 XP (was based on player level).
[*] Completing onslaughts now grants 1,000 XP.
[*] Reduced the range of the Cleric's ability: Genesis.
[*] Mines now have a 5% chance of giving 1-3 Vulcanite.
[*] Tier tokens will now only drop when you are at least level 20.
[*] Reduced the amount of mana drained by Champion or Gladiator enemies with the mana drain modifier.
[*] Increased the damage of enemies.
[*] Enemies will no longer melee their target.
[*] Cleric's absorption shields no longer reflect damage back to attackers.
[*] Onslaught keys' weights no longer scale with level.
[*] The Wizard skills: Improved Meteor Strike and Improved Incinerate have switched places in the skill tree.
[*] The Champion skills: Improved Whirlwind and Frenzied Bombardment have switched places in the skill tree.
[*] Reduced the range of the Champion's ability: Whirlwind.
[*] Completing an Onslaught faster will level up the key higher (up to 4 levels).
[*] Strength now also increases your base defense.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the minimap was only displaying the background.
[*] Fixed an issue where talking to the Cardinal when he had no dialgoue would cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where armor granting talent points into Magisterial Consecration would cause it to be lowered instead of increased.
[*] Fixed an issue where dropping health, mana, or rejuvination potions would cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where equiping an item recently merged with socketed runes would cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where selling/dropping miscellaneous items would cause the wrong Onslaught to be loaded or the game crashed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cardinal dialogue was not being displayed correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where some modifiers would spawn with a 0 on low-level characters.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Necromaner's ability: Army of the Dead's summoned minions were not lasting the amount of time proposed in the tooltip.
[*] Fixed an issue where ressetting your skill points would have your skills be at negative values.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player's casting animation was not lasting the entire duration of the cast.
[*] Fixed an issue where Regenreation would increase in value the longer the buff has been applied.
[*] Fixed an issue where could open up chests out of line of sight.
[*] Fixed an issue where ability tooltips were appearing behind player buffs.
[*] Fixed an issue where player buffs would start to appear off the screen when the player got more than 24.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Champion tier set: Expose Weakness's four piece not working as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where having low skill points in the Champion's skill: The King's Rally would extend Rallying Cry indefinitely.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Champion's ability: Execution Sentence was not dealing increased damage against bleeding targets.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.4.0 - Tier Set Update
notes.notes:
This update contains the Tier Sets, balance changes, and improvements.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added tier sets.
[*] Added tier tokens which drop from enemies that can convert any equipment item into a tier piece.
[*] Enemies now have a 2% chance to drop a merge token.
[*] Added a hit particle effect that comes from enemies when they melee swing at the player.
[*] Artifact chests now always drop artifact items.
[*] Onslaught keys will no longer degrade in value when not completing the Onslaught within the time limit.
[*] Added a new offhand weapon: Preserved Head.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a confirmation when attempting to leave a campaign or onslaught that is not yet completed.
[*] The chat can now handle in text formatting.
[*] Improved the blood particle effect.
[*] Added a flame effect whenever the Wizard class is under the effects of Cremation.
[*] Added a popup notification whenever you level up or an onslaught/campaign is completed.
[*] Improved the Cardinal's dialogue system.
[*] Improved the text action buttons for items in the inventory.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the damage of the Cleric's ability: Holy Malice, Atonement, Crusade, Redemption, and Genesis.
[*] Reduced the maximum channel time and cooldown of the Cleric's ability: Redemption by 2 seconds.
[*] The Wizard's skill: Kindling now only reduces the cooldown of Cremation when it is not active. 
[*] Increased the damage of the Wizard's ability: Blast Furnace.
[*] The Wizard's skill: Conflagration now causes Meteor Strike and Meteor shower to extend the current duration of Cremation by 0.30 seconds (was 1 second).
[*] Increased the damage of minions summoned by the Necromancer's ability: Raise Dead.
[*] Reduced the damage of minions summoned by the Necromancer's abilty: Army of the Dead.
[*] Reduced the damage of the Necromancer's ability: Hemorrhaging Assault.
[*] The Necromancer's ability: Soul Rupture now grants a soul when used on a target below 35% of their maximum health.
[*] Increased the base cooldown of the Necromancer's ability: Raise Dead by 3 seconds.
[*] Increased the damage of the Champion's ability: Colossal Smash.
[*] Reduced the damage of the Champion's ability: King's Despair.
[*] Reduced the bleed damage of the Champion's ability: King's Despair.
[*] Reduced the duration of Rallying Cry extended through the Champion's skill: The King's Rally to 0.25/0.30/0.35/0.40/0.45 seconds (was 0.25/0.50/0.75/1/1.25 seconds).
[*] The Champion's skill: The King's Rally now no longer causes Rallying Cry to grant 25% bonus damage.
[*] The Champion's skill: Masterful King's Despair now only reduces the cooldown of Rallying Cry when it is not active.
[*] Completing objectives on a max level character will no longer yield experience.
[*] Necromancers are now able to use wands.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Wizard's skill: Conflagration was not causing Meteor Strike and Meteor Shower to properly extend the current duration of Cremation.
[*] Fixed an issue where the indestructible item modifier caused the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where shields were dropping for classes that could not use heavy armor from the campaign chest and causing the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where having no gear would cause your scathing, perseverance, and resilience chances to be NaN.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Champion's ability: Furious Slash was not properly reducing the cooldown of Colossal Smash.
[*] Fixed an issue where hovering over a enemy buff as the enemy died would cause the game to cash.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.3.0 - Forge Update
notes.notes:
This update contains the new forge, campaign chest, and revamped leveling and xp curve.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the forge, where you can merge two items in order to make a single more powerful item.
[*] Added the campaign chest which drops loot after completing a campaign.
[*] Revamped the leveling and xp curve.
[*] Added functionality to the perseverance stat.
[*] Added a world map of the current map the player is on (default key bind is M).
[*] Added the following modifiers: bonus xp on kill.
[*] Added the following consumables: Phial of Dexterity, Strength Potion, Phial of Vitality, and Flask of Intelligence.
[/list]


[h1]Quality of Life Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Holding shift when hovering over an item in your inventory will now display the current equipped item's tooltip next to the hovered item's tooltip.
[*] Improved the tooltips on all the anvil buttons in the crafting interface.
[*] Targeted enemy buffs are now displayed under their health bar.
[*] Player buffs are now displayed to the right of the player's mana orb.
[*] The runes in the item tooltips are now sorted by socket color.
[*] You are now asked to confirm when deleting a character.
[*] Added tooltips to the inventory section buttons.
[*] Added a loading screen in between loading worlds (fixes the freezing problem).
[*] Added help tooltips to the character panel to give information on each attribute.
[*] Added a button on the right side of the screen to open up your ore inventory.
[*] All execute abilities now glow when the player's target is within the ability's respective execute range.
[*] Improved the tooltip of some abilities.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Two handed weapons now have double the amount of modifiers, runes, and damage when compared to a one-handed weapon.
[*] All items now have a maximum 4 rune sockets (except two handed weapons which can have a maximum of 8).
[*] Consumables now have a cooldown before they can be used again after a use.
[*] Increased the range of the Cleric's abilities: Atonement and Crusade by 400%.
[*] Cast ability modifiers now require Vulcanite to increase their percentage.
[*] Crafted two handed weapons can now use up to 20 Vulcanite (was 10).
[*] When an enemy deals a crushing blow, a larger percentage of the player's defense is ignored.
[*] Reduced the chance of enemies inflicting a crushing blow to 10% (was 20%).
[*] When calculating item level, main hand and off handed weapons are counted as one slot (was two).
[*] The Necromancer's skill: Improved Soul Rupture now causes Soul Rupture's execute effect to extend the life of all your minions by 2/4 seconds (was 0.5/1 seconds).
[*] The Wizard's skill: Improved Blast Furnace now causes Blast Furnace's execute effect to have a 30/65/100% chance to reset the cooldown of Vaporize (was 20/40/60%).
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with increase attribute buffs and the legion onslaught affix giving strength instead of dexterity to Necromancers.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Wizard's ability: Freezing Typhoon would cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where Heavy and Medium equipment defense/attack were not being generated higher than Light equipment.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Wizard's ability: Blast Furnace was improperly applying Combustion charges when used against targets below 35% of their maximum health.
[*] Fixed an issue where ability tooltips were displaying behind another ability's glow effect.
[*] Repositioned the NPC, Anvil, and Campaign Selector panels to no longer overlap the player's action bar.
[*] Picking up an item that exceeds your maximum carry weight will now cause the item to reposition onto the player.
[*] Fixed the scaling issue of stacking buffs together.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies would deal negative damage against players with high defense.
[*] Fixed an issue where crafting certain modifiers would not subtract the correct number of ore used.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could craft an item with negative defense/attack.
[*] Fixed an issue with some GUI elements not scaling up when on larger screens.
[*] You are no longer able to make modifiers that can only be used by a different class.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.2.0 - Necromancer Update
notes.notes:
This update contains the new Necromancer class.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the Necromancer class
[*] Added new item modifiers for the new Necromancer class.
[*] Enemies will now path find towards the player after engagement.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Overhauled the character creation screen.
[*] Updated the art for the health, mana, and rejuvenation potions.
[*] Made the consumable count bigger on the consumable buttons.
[*] Only your class's class specific item modifiers will appear on dropped items.
[*] Your DPS is now only sent to the chat if combat logging is enabled.
[*] Some buffs are no longer reapplied but now applied to an already existing buff (they are now stackable on the same buff instance).
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The player's carry weight is now based on their base strength (was total strength).
[*] The Champion's skill: King's Rally now only extends the current duration of Rallying Cry.
[*] The Champion's skill: King's Rally now increases all damage by 25% when Rallying Cry is active.
[*] Increased the damage of the Champion's ability: Colossal Smash by 500%.
[*] The Wizard's skill: Smoldering Crater now causes all meteors too leave behind flame patch (was only Meteor Shower).
[*] The Wizard's skill: Smoldering Crater's patch now is created at the target location (was at the player).
[*] Reduced the base cooldown of the Wizard's abilitiy: Vaporize to 6 seconds (was 8 seconds).
[*] Increased the damage of the Wizard's ability: Vaporize by 350%.
[*] Increased the damage of the Cleric's ability: Atonement by 300%.
[*] Increased the damage of the Cleric's ability: Crusade by 250%.
[*] Increased the damage dealt by the Cleric skill: Sanctified Malice to 425% (was 400%).
[*] Reduced the vigor cost the Cleric's ability: Crusade to 75 vigor (was 80).
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] When creating a new character, all spaces in character names are now removed.
[*] Environment, chest, and mine tooltips are no longer displayed when a GUI panel is displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue regarding the wizard ability casts on hit modifiers.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could create a character with no name.
[*] Fixed an issue where buffs were getting stronger towards the end of their duration rather than being constant.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed you to interact with environment objects regardless of range and line of sight.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.1.0 - Crafting & Boss Update
notes.notes:
This update consists of new features such as: crafting, bosses, and new utility abilities for each class.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the ore inventory.
[*] Added ores and each campaign now has a specific ore.
[*] Added crafting.
[*] Added 3 new utility abilties to the Champion, Cleric, and Wizard classes.
[*] Added a new action bar that now contains all the consumables the player can keybind to.
[*] Added new environment objects.
[*] Added map triggers.
[*] Added bosses.
[*] Added a new item modifier: Bonus Gold which gives more gold when they pickup gold.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] When the player dies, they now automatically deselect their target.
[*] When the player dies all their cooldowns are reset.
[*] Made the modifier descriptions on the Onslaught selection screen smaller.
[*] The player can now walk over gold to automatically pick it up.
[*] Updated the consumable tooltips.
[*] Updated the tooltips of items when they are on the ground.
[*] The Cleric's vigor bar and the enemy health bars are now slightly animated.
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced the absorb shield casted by items through the Cleric ability: Sanctified Escutcheon by 75%.
[*] The Cleric skill: Sanctified Malice: now drains 5/10/15/20/25% of your absorb shield (was 1/2/3/4/5%).
[*] Increased the damage dealt by the Cleric skill: Sanctified Malice to 400% (was 10%).
[*] Increased the range of the Wizard's ability: Meteor Shower by 400%.
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved the item, enemy, and onslaught modifiers into the data folder, rather than being built in.
[*] Moved the consumable and buff functionality into the data folder, rather than being built in.
[*] Campaign files are now stored inside of folders in the campaigns folder (located in the game directory).
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed how Dexterity calculates the global cooldown.
[*] Fixed a bug where having a lot of points in the Champion skill: Improved Furious Slash caused Furious Slash to extend the cooldown of Colossal Smash.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Cleric's ability: Exodus not working as intended or at all.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Cleric's ability: Genesis still taking away Vigor even when it should have been casted for free.
[*] Fixed an issue with that allowed the player to enter a campaign in Freeplay even if it was locked.
[*] Fixed an issue where the health and mana values were not displayed on top of the health and mana globes, respectively.
[*] Fixed an issue where talking to the cardinal when out of range would cause the player not being able to see his dialogue.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could buy an item even if it exceeded their maximum carry weight.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8.0.0 - Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
This update consists of onslaught improvements, quality of life features, balance changes, fixes, and the addition of multiplayer.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added multiplayer.
[*] Added a new enemy modifier: Eradication which causes the enemy to remove their target's current absorption shield.
[*] Player save files are now verified to ensure legit play (Unverified player save files are no not eligible for steam achievments and cannot participate in multiplayer).
[/list]

[h1]Onslaught Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Onslaughts now have a defined level.
[*] Onslaught keys now always have at least three modifiers, regardless of level.
[*] Completing a higher level onslaught key now grants higher rewards.
[*] Completing higher onslaughts now increases the item level of items sold at the shop.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved the item, rune, ability and consumable button tooltips.
[*] Fixed the spacing on the Onslaught panel in the campaign selector.
[*] Redesigned the torches, blood, and death particles.
[*] Class skill and ability cast modifiers no longer appear on weapons.
[*] Class skill and ability cast modifiers are now only present on their intended equipment.
[*] The GUI on larger screens should now be displayed correctly
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Damage done by enemies attacking absorption shields now only apply to the Cleric class.
[*] Increased the damage of the Cleric ability: Atonement by 25%.
[*] The Cleric's skill: Sanctified Malice now only increases the current absorption shield to a maximum of 50% of the Cleric's maximum health.
[*] Removed the enemy modifier: lifesteal
[*] Increased the mana cost of the Cleric abilities: Sanctified Escutcheon and Atonement by 500%.
[*] Cleric abilities casted by items/skills no longer generate vigor.
[*] Increased the damage fo the Wizard abilities: Vaporize, Meteor Strike, and Meteor Shower.
[*] Increased the damage of the Wizard's abilities: Fireball, Vaporize, and Meteor Shower by 400%.
[*] Increased the damage of the Wizard's ability: Meteor Strike by 300%. 
[*] Increased the damage of the Wizard's ability: Incinerate by 200%.
[*] The Wizard's ability: Blast Furnace now deals 500% increased damage against targets with less than 30% of their maximum health.
[*] The Wizard's talent: Improved Fireball now gives Fireball an extra 15/20/25/30/35% chance of inflicting a scathing blow (was 5/7/9/11/15% chance).
[*] Reduced the mana cost of the Wizard's ability: Fireball by 75%.
[*] The Cleric's skill: Sanctified Malice now causes Holy Malice to drain your current absorption shield, dealing 10% of the amount drained to the Cleric's current target.
[*] Reduced the absorption amount granted by the Cleric's ability: Sanctified Escutcheon by 50%.
[*] Absorption shields now reflect 400% of damage received (was 200%).
[*] The Cleric's ability: Redemption now generates triple vigor every second when used on target below 35% of their maximum health.
[*] The player can no longer have an absorption shield above 50% of their maximum health.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where life and mana steal modifiers had a negative chance of happening.
[*] Fixed an issue where running away from a selected npc would crash the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where starting an onslaught would crash the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the chests spawned at the end of an onslaught were not dropping higher loot.
[*] Fixed an issue where selling an item would cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where losing durability on an item with an indestructable modifer on a socketed rune would cause the game to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where a runes' rarity wasn't loaded properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where player's were not spawning with full mana and health values.
[*] Fixed an issue where killing an Ambomination in the Legion onslaught affix was not giving the correct main stat.
[*] Fixed an issue with the player's item level not being calculated correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Wizard's ability: Vaporize would scale with strength instead of intelligence.
[*] Fixed an issue where while the Wizard's ability: Cremation was active all ability cooldowns and cast times were removed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the time played would not update on the select character screen after loading in a character.
[/list]
